name: yilong-project-memory
description: Bounded, evidence-backed project navigation memory for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Open only the project context needed for this task.
interface.longDescription: Adds a bounded read-only context planner, an on-demand single-tool feature workflow, and a separate review-gated receipt channel backed by the local Yilong node. Current source and binding project rules always outrank shared navigation memory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use bounded project memory on demand; verify current files natively, and record only durable evidence-backed facts.
